column1: # Game profile of Digimon Story Time Stranger (Switch, update 1.2.2 = v262144, with its add-on content). PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title).
# Media.Vision's engine on NVN, SDK 20.5.21, CRIWARE sound and movies; every game file is in MVGL archives (*.nx64.mvgl, the 64-bit layout: mvgl.py) and two CRI CPK archives.
# The shaders are the archives' 'shad' entries, NXVS / NXFS containers of one NVN control section and code area each (shader_split.py mvgl_jobs). Started as a provisional profile
# (dm/games/profile_guess.py): the memory keys are the survey's guess, not measured

# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# the rewritten modules (main 51.4 MB, subsdk0 13.7 MB, sdk 7.2 MB) are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (profile_guess.mem_used)
# PEANUTS: FPSLocker Warehouse's config for this build (v4, 010062E01FE0C000/135C83CDEA06AEC2.yaml), main 1.2.2 only. The host's frame limit picks the rate: 60 by default,
# the launcher's choices up to 120, and Game owned for the game's own rate (no row applied). The frame time (µs) and the frame rate the game keeps in main's data:
# Dynamic resolution: main+0x9d6868 / +0x9d687c loaded x21 with the address of a table of two modes, three floats each (main+0x9d6884 reads table[mode * 12]).
# The plan points x21 at the auxiliary data page instead (adrp x21, its page; add x21, x21, #0), whose mode 0 follows the limit: fps + 2, 1000 / (fps + 5) and 0.78 of that;
# mode 1 keeps the config's constants (56, 16.949152, 13). The data words before the first frame are the config's defaults (25, 35.714287, 28)
